sous_titre: Part des postes Windows encore sous Windows 10, en %, octobre 2025

series.nom: Part des postes encore sous Windows 10

Amérique du Sud.texte: In South America, Windows 11 share was 73.14%, while Windows 10 was 21.91%.

Amérique du Nord.texte: In North America was 63.88% as of the end of October, compared to 33.07% for Windows 10.

Monde.texte: Globally, Windows 11 market share stands at 55.17%, while Windows 10 is 41.74%.

Europe.texte: In Europe, Windows 11 share is only 52.37%, with Windows 10 close behind at 45.16%.

Asie.texte: In Asia, where the market share for Windows 10 was 49.81%, compared to 47.17% for Windows 11.
